title: Subtractions
statementMd:
You've got two numbers. As long as they are both larger than zero, they go through the same operation: subtract the lesser number from the larger one. If they equal substract one number from the another. For example, one operation transforms pair (4,17) to pair (4,13), it transforms (5,5) to (0,5).

You've got some number of pairs ($*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$). How many operations will be performed for each of them?

## Input

The first line contains the number of pairs $*n*$ ($1  ≤  *n*  ≤  1000$). Then follow $*n*$ lines, each line contains a pair of positive integers $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ ($1  ≤  *a*_{*i*},  *b*_{*i*}  ≤  10^{9}$).

## Output

Print the sought number of operations for each pair on a single line.
statementZhMd:
你有两个数。只要它们都大于零，就对它们执行相同的操作：从较大的数中减去较小的数。如果两个数相等，则从其中一个数中减去另一个数。例如，一次操作会将数对 (4,17) 变为数对 (4,13)，将 (5,5) 变为 (0,5)。

现在有若干个数对 ($*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$)。对于每个数对，将执行多少次操作？

## 输入格式

第一行包含数对的数量 $*n*$（$1  ≤  *n*  ≤  1000$）。接下来 $*n*$ 行，每行包含一对正整数 $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$（$1  ≤  *a*_{*i*},  *b*_{*i*}  ≤  10^{9}$）。

## 输出格式

对于每个数对，单独一行输出所求的操作次数。
